shared_elements: bird or bird-like creature in profile
horizontal band of repeating geometric pattern
justification: Both fields are vertical and contain horizontal bands of repeating geometric ornament along with animal/bird forms rendered in profile, and both include arm-and-hand motifs, but in A everything is subordinated to a single large frontal anthropomorph while B stacks small animals in separate registers on a plain ground. The manner of rendering is entirely different: flat, saturated, hard-edged coloured outline drawing versus shallow monochrome carving in weathered stone photographed in situ.
